name: new_bank_v2_electrode_shift_8ch
dataset: LibEMG CIILData native eight-channel 200 Hz electrode shift
features: F0v2 source-rest adjacent-difference noise thresholds; F2a centered fixed-0.05-shrinkage trace covariance; F3c circular-lag summaries of the same covariance; 40-sample windows omit temporal half drift
classifier: source-trial StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
aggregation: at most eight nonoverlapping 200 ms windows averaged to one feature vector per native trial
selection: maximize pooled validation macro-F1, break ties by lower pooled validation log loss; do not select on final subjects
boundary: same-user before/after wearing transfer on a public 200 Hz device; no current-device or live claim
